modules.live_check: Not called live (keyed, no company key): NEEDS_KEY before any request asserted live; licence-blocked under corporate (key-terms) until key_plans.grayhat=business. The 401 'You don't have access to API' body is a real research capture.

core_requests: P321 error markers: allow a declared 'absence' outcome for documented provider decisions (Hunter HTTP 451 'unavailable_for_legal_reasons' = person opted out) instead of the generic 451 geo_block classification; hunter_io_finder maps it module-side through a maps_to 'error' marker (which also keeps the circuit from tripping).

Core 'generated' provenance flag on entities (set by generator modules such as hunter_io_finder and name_permutations, honoured by policy.decide for account-revealing/key-server modules); proton_pks refuses depth>0, any provenance and known generator modules/relations (guessed_email, generated_candidate) module-side (P092 cond 1).

A value-free org fact store writable by own-asset modules (e.g. ctx.org facts: own-domain address pattern from hunter_io) so the offline hunter_sender_check gets the pattern without the manual 'v3lum config set hunter_sender_check_patterns' step (P090 cond 4); modules cannot read another module's ctx.state.
Case metadata naming the investigated company/domain (P091 cond 5 'the case company's domain'); pgp_keyservers uses 'analyst-typed seed + recorded purpose' meanwhile.
A structured person-at-organisation seed (or case context) for P090 cond 3; hunter_io_finder parses person_name 'First Last @ example.com' or the setting hunter_io_finder_domain.
P311 renderer: seeds-only privacy links (pivot pack flag) so email_keys_calendar:gcal_public_ics is offered only for analyst-typed seeds (P093 cond 3).
Export layer (P303/WP21): drop or gate attribute own_domain_addresses and published_address pivots in bulk exports (P090 cond 4 'never bulk-exported').
AR20 safety suite (e): include a query-string key (Hunter api_key=) in the fake-key grep over cache, evidence, events, reports and case DB (P090 cond 5).

Sanitizer second net: a boolean credential-leak flag ('credentials_leaked': true) is dropped as a credential field; emailrep renames it leak_reported. A metadata-boolean exemption (bool values under credential-like keys) would let modules keep provider names.
notes: All six proposals delivered (P089 emailrep; P090 as hunter_io (own-asset-only domain search, run_on own_assets_only), hunter_io_count (counts only, third parties, purpose), hunter_io_finder (typed person, purpose, generated pivot expand=False) and the offline hunter_sender_check (BEC lookalike + own-domain pattern); P091 pgp_keyservers; P092 proton_pks; P093 google_calendar_ics; P138 grayhatwarfare).
